explanation_template: Council Tax liability: {outcome}. Band {band}, annual charge £{amount}. Discounts applied: {discounts}

edge_cases.description: Property is a second home (furnished but not main residence)
edge_cases.action: Apply second home premium (up to 200% additional charge). Confirm with council for local policy.

edge_cases.description: Property has been empty for 1+ years
edge_cases.action: Apply empty home premium (1-4x normal rate depending on duration). May qualify for 12-month exception if being sold/renovated.

edge_cases.description: All household members are full-time students
edge_cases.action: Property exempt from Council Tax. Require student certificates from educational institutions.

edge_cases.description: Household member is severely mentally impaired
edge_cases.action: May qualify for 25-100% discount depending on household composition. Requires GP certificate and benefits eligibility.

edge_cases.description: Property adapted for disabled occupant with extra space/facilities
edge_cases.action: May qualify for band reduction (one band lower). Requires assessment of extra room/wheelchair space.

edge_cases.description: Property owner deceased, probate not yet granted or within 6 months
edge_cases.action: No Council Tax due until probate granted, then 6-month exemption if property remains empty and in deceased's name.

edge_cases.description: Property uninhabitable due to major structural works
edge_cases.action: May be removed from Council Tax list during works. Must notify council when habitable again.

edge_cases.description: Only one adult resident, all others disregarded
